description: Convert an amount in a currency to words for cheques, invoices and contracts, in 56 languages. Arabic output applies number–noun agreement (درهم واحد / درهمان / ثلاثة دراهم / أحد عشر درهماً) and the correct minor unit (فلس، هللة، قرش…); English uses CLDR currency names. style='cheque' adds the customary wrapper. Example: amount 1250.50, currency 'AED', language 'ar', style 'cheque'. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[]; deterministic (no AI inside), nothing logged.

amount.description: Amount as number or numeric string, e.g. 1234567.89 or '١٢٣٤٫٥٠'.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: ISO 4217 code: AED, SAR, USD, EUR…
currency.title: Currency

language.description: Language of the words: 'en', 'ar', 'fr', 'de', 'es', 'hi', 'ur'… (56 languages; list_languages).
language.title: Language

style.description: cheque wraps the phrase the way cheques/contracts do ('… only' / 'فقط … لا غير').
style.title: Style

name: amount_to_words
title: Write a money amount in words
